He is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] from [[Verdanturf Town]]. ==In animation== [[File:The Phantom.png|220px|thumb|left|Timmy as "Phantom"]] With the help of [[Tommy Grimm|his father]], Timmy created his '''Phantom''' (Japanese: '''ファントム''' ''Phantom'') alter-ego to remain anonymous while he competed in {{pkmn|Contest}}s against the wishes of [[Mrs. Grimm|his mother]], who instead wanted him to study so he could eventually take over the family business. Timmy debuted in ''[[AG061|Disaster of Disguise]]'', where he had a battle against {{Ash}} but had to flee after his mother arrived. Ash and {{ashfr}} were later hired by Mrs. Grimm to uncover Phantom's identity, but after finding out Timmy's motives, they instead supported him in his Contest ambitions. {{an|Brock}} later convinced Mrs. Grimm that he was Phantom in a ploy. In ''[[AG062|Disguise Da Limit]]'', Timmy sneaked out with the help of his father and competed in the Verdanturf Town [[Pokémon Contest]]. He performed well, earning himself a high score of 27.8 in the [[Appeal|Appeals Round]]. He later defeated [[Jessie|Jesslana]] and her {{TP|Jessie|Dustox}} and advanced to the finals, where he competed against {{an|May}}. His parents arrived at the [[Contest Hall]], with his mother particularly furious at Timmy. However, she had a change of heart after recalling her own past and started cheering for her son. Despite Timmy's efforts, however, May had more points remaining and was announced as the winner of the Contest. Afterwards, his mother allowed him to compete in future Contests as long as he kept up with his homework. In ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]'', Timmy was watching May at the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]]. He appears to know {{an|Chaz}}, as he was seen watching the [[Grand Festival]] with him. ===Character=== Timmy is the only child of wealthy parents, and his mother originally disapproved of him competing in Pokémon Contests. However, he managed to convince her to let him compete as long as he didn't fall behind in his studies. Timmy is a strong battler, using a barrage of attacks to take down opponents like [[Drew's Roselia]] and [[Jessie's Dustox]]. However, only his Phantom disguise gave him the confidence to boldly challenge other {{pkmn|Trainer}}s. As his alter-ego, Timmy created a lot of mystery, as he would appear and vanish with a powerful wind with dark petals. Without his disguise, Timmy was initially a shy and anxious person, but after his mother found out his secret and eventually came to support his Contest ambitions, Timmy gained more self-confidence. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Timmy's known Pokémon: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Timmy Grimm |pkmn=Dusclops |stage1=Duskull |type1=Ghost |img=Timmy Grimm Duskull.png |cap=Timmy Grimm's Duskull |img2=Timmy Grimm Dusclops.png |epnum=AG061 |epname=Disaster of Disguise |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |vaen= |desc={{p|Dusclops}} is Timmy's only known Pokémon. It was revealed in a flashback that he had owned Dusclops since it was a {{p|Duskull}}, which he found one night while it was lost. In ''[[AG061|Disaster of Disguise]]'', Dusclops defeated [[Drew's Roselia]] in a battle, causing [[Drew]] to not register for the upcoming Verdanturf Contest. Timmy later challenged {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Pikachu}}, though the match was interrupted by the arrival of [[Mrs. Grimm|Timmy's mother]]. Timmy used Dusclops during the Verdanturf Contest, and its combination of Will-O-Wisp and Psychic allowed him to proceed to the Battle Round. There, Dusclops won against [[Jessie's Dustox]] after the timer ran out. Timmy also used Dusclops against [[May's Skitty]]. Though Dusclops initially had the advantage, Skitty's {{m|Assist}} allowed May to counter Dusclops and its oncoming attacks. When the five minutes were up, May was announced the winner as she had more points remaining. It made a cameo appearance in ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]'', where it was watching May competing in the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]] on [[television]].
